name: Betoverens: A Breathless Ribbons Anthology
source:
A collection of steamy, spicy, detailed short stories from the Breathless Ribbons Universe centered around fanmade MCs.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一套以《Breathless Ribbons》世界觀為背景的短篇故事集，火辣香豔、描寫細緻，圍繞粉絲原創的主角們展開。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
